interface.name: error
interface.description:
FALSE: No error occurred;
TRUE: Error occurred during execution of FB

scan_semantics: At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.
safety_priority: Invalid range is diagnosed before invalid hysteresis width.
No alarm update is allowed in an invalid-configuration scan.
assumptions: Threshold comparisons are strict as written. Equality with trigger or release thresholds retains the previous alarm value.
Invalid configuration returns early, preserving alarm outputs. error and status are recalculated each scan; valid configuration clears them.
loLevel>=hiLevel takes priority over the hysteresis-width error. hystWindow is assumed nonnegative; negative values are outside the defined input domain.

formal_properties.explanation: Invalid limits take priority and leave alarms unchanged.
The hysteresis range must be smaller than the limit separation.
Valid input clears transient configuration errors.
A high excursion activates the high alarm.
Below the strict release boundary, high alarm clears.
The high hysteresis band retains history.
A low excursion activates the low alarm.
Above the strict low release boundary, low alarm clears.
The low hysteresis band retains history.

atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or observed output.
